title: Songbook manifest, version 1
description: A songbook.json: a named list of Guitar Pro files. Served on its own, song URLs resolve against the manifest's URL; inside a .sbk zip they resolve against the folder holding songbook.json. Extensions go in properties prefixed with "x-", which readers ignore.

$schema.description: URI of this schema, so editors can validate the file.

songbook.description: Format version. An incompatible future format will use a new number.

description.description: One or two sentences about the songbook.

text.description: A string with at least one non-whitespace character. Readers trim it.

url.description: Where the Guitar Pro file (.gp3, .gp4, .gp5, .gpx or .gp) is: a relative reference, resolved as described above, or an absolute http(s) URL. Other schemes are rejected.

id.description: Stable slug used in links (/p/<id>) and to store favourites; keep it when editing the book. Should be unique within the songbook: readers suffix repeats ("air", "air-2"). Defaults to a slug of the file name.

title.description: Display title. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

examples.name: Bach Guitar Songbook
examples.description: Pieces by J. S. Bach arranged for guitar.
